Card Q&A.a:
No, you can't.  This card's [All Turns] effect triggers when this card attacks an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards.  It won't trigger if it attacks a Digimon with digivolution cards, therefore you can't activate it.

Card Q&A.q: This card has BT16-016 [Patamon] in its digivolution cards and attacked an opponent's Digimon that has 1 digivolution card. At such times, can I use BT16-016 [Patamon]'s inherited effect to trash the digivolution card of the opponent's Digimon and then activate this card's [Your Turn] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[Your Turn] When this Digimon attacks an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, delete that Digimon.
